about: Committed source-divergence reports (JEG-460) with the served-week and source-date provenance matched by fixture build. Copied from git blobs by extract_receipts.py; nothing fetched or synthesized. null means the provenance was not found in history.

scoring_bases.sha256:4534dff3d4c1e828: 12-team, 1-QB leagues. STD / Half / Full PPR columns; QB table has 1QB / 6-pt-TD / Superflex columns. QB uses the 1QB column for all scoring (no per-scoring QB column published).
scoring_bases.sha256:76aa9c91bf27f2b5: 12-team, 1-QB leagues. non / 0.5 / PPR columns; QB table has 1QB-4 / 1QB-6 / 2QB columns. QB uses the 1QB-4 column for all scoring (no per-scoring 1QB column published).
scoring_bases.sha256:8212af276570e006: CBS rest-of-season projections (nonppr page; half/full PPR computed as CBS fpts + 0.5/1.0 per reception, per-game = ROS/gp), translated to the 0-70 scale with the DDF two-tier value-above-waivers method. CBS projections only; no expert blend.
scoring_bases.sha256:9e2b658bd3e15312: Razzball rest-of-season projections (published PPG columns; doubling-quirk safe), translated to the 0-70 scale with the DDF two-tier value-above-waivers method. Razzball projections only; no expert blend.
scoring_bases.sha256:c2910ee03a81d20e: ESPN season fantasy projections (Mike Clay model) where priced; ECR fills the rest. Valued through our pinned starter model.
scoring_bases.sha256:cb022e983c0cc32d: 12-team, 1-QB leagues. One base Value column (plus 2QB Value for QBs and TEP Value for TEs); the base Value is scoring-agnostic and is reused for STD / Half / Full PPR.
scoring_bases.sha256:dabef6f5261d65d5: Redraft, rest-of-season. Scoring x team count x 1-QB/2-QB per pull. FantasyCalc's 2QB setting is their own implementation, not necessarily superflex.
